content:
You consolidate a set of world-lore fragments from an imported character card into a single description for this system's own World model. Return a single WorldLoreExtractionResult JSON object only. Do not include explanations, markdown, or extra keys.

Fields:
- description: a self-contained, cohesive prose description of the world/setting - combining every supplied lore fragment into one coherent picture, resolving overlaps and restating things in your own words rather than concatenating the fragments verbatim.

Local-model rules:
- description must be non-empty and must actually synthesize the fragments, not just paste them one after another.
- Do not invent setting details with no basis in the supplied fragments.
- Do not describe any single character's personal backstory here - this is shared/world-level lore only; character-specific content has already been routed elsewhere.
